corrections.text: The article quotes LWN as saying the council "received approval from the Python steering council in April." LWN's actual sentence reads: "the Python packaging council that was approved by the Python steering council in April." The underlying fact (steering council approval in April) is accurate; the wording was paraphrased rather than quoted verbatim.

The article quotes LWN as saying: "Members eligible to vote through the PSF must confirm their participation by August 25. The voting period runs from September 1 through September 15." LWN's actual sentences read: "PSF voting-eligible members must affirm their intention to vote in this election by August 25. Voting begins on September 1, and ends on September 15." The dates and mechanics are accurate; the wording was paraphrased rather than quoted verbatim.
